obvious_hallucination.reason: The claimed ANOVA error degrees of freedom (df=36) are mathematically impossible given the experimental setup in the repository. In a 3×3 balanced factorial design with error df=36: N - (number of parameters) = 36, where parameters = intercept + 2 (factor A) + 2 (factor B) + 4 (interaction) = 9, so N must equal 45 (5 replications per cell). However, project_summary.json explicitly shows only 5 total simulations were run (1 run per group, not 5 replications per cell). The two_way_anova.py tool (OLS-based) would yield error df = 5 - 9 = -4 (underdetermined system) with 5 observations. Furthermore, 4 of the 9 group configurations have wrong information_flow parameters: treatment_medium_openness_fifth_order has third-order_neighbors, treatment_medium_openness_first_order has third-order_neighbors, treatment_very_high_openness_third_order has first-order_neighbors, and treatment_very_low_openness_third_order has fifth-order_neighbors. The F statistics with df=36 are fabricated and cannot have been produced by the repository's experimental setup.
